{{Quote|The old order is dead. Long live the new order.|Callef|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], a '''duel''' occurred in a [[Gnarls cave|cave]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] between the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] apprentice [[Callef]] and a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi apprentice]]. In an attempt to stop the [[Flesh Raider]] invasion of the Gnarls, the [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] found Callef about to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] apprentice [[Unaw Aharo]], and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in an attempt to stop him. Despite the apprentice's disadvantage of wielding a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] against Callef's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Jedi's remarkable combat skill resulted in Callef's death.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You are&hellip; dangerous. You killed my soldiers.|Callef, to the Padawan|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]]. It was revealed that the Flesh Raiders were acting under the orders of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]], the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], who wished to destroy the Order and rebuild it into something that could destroy the Sith. Early in the uprising,<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the Flesh Raiders [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attacked]] the Order's base in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]], near the [[Masters' Retreat]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by Jedi Master [[Derrin Weller]], fought off the Flesh Raider attacks, but Master Weller was injured in the fight. Weller had already sent a [[Hero of Tython|newly-arrived apprentice]] out into the Gnarls to investigate reports of the Flesh Raiders using [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology, and Weller contacted the Padawan after he was injured. Having learned from a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] apprentice by the name of [[Unaw Aharo]] that the Flesh Raiders were entering the Gnarls through a [[Gnarls cave|cave network]] nearby, the Jedi Master ordered the Padawan&mdash;who was known to be exceptionally skilled in combat&mdash;to find Aharo and seal off the cavern at all costs.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==The duel==
[[File:Flesh_Raider_tunnel.png|thumb|left|300px|Flesh Raiders come through the tunnel]]
{{Quote|&laquo;He commands the Flesh Raiders attacking us.&raquo;<br />''"''Not attacking&mdash;cleansing. And we have only begun.|quotestart=0|Unaw Aharo and Callef, to the Padawan who rescues Aharo|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
Entering the cave, the apprentice was forced to fight through thirteen Flesh Raiders, and finally reached the end of one section of the cave. There, the apprentice found a wounded Aharo being threatened by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] Dark Jedi named [[Callef]]&mdash;in actuality, the apprentice of Bengel Morr, though Callef did not mention his master to the two Jedi apprentices. The [[Gender/Legends|man]], who wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and called himself a "true Jedi," attacked the second apprentice when the Jedi stopped him from [[Death/Legends|killing]] Aharo. Despite only wielding a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], the Padawan was able to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|defeat]] Callef, and the Dark Jedi was killed during the battle.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Thank the Force that you're safe. This man's no Jedi&mdash;at least, not one of us.|Jedi Master Orgus Din, after arriving at the scene|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
It was at that point that Jedi Master Orgus Din arrived and witnessed Callef's defeat. Din thanked the apprentice for helping Aharo, and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|bring down]] the cave's ceiling, blocking the path and stopping any more Flesh Raiders from entering the Gnarls. Din then took the wounded Aharo to safety, telling the other apprentice to come to the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

[[File:Bringing_down_the_house.png|thumb|right|240px|Orgus Din seals the cave with telekinesis.]]
When the apprentice met with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] at the Temple, Master Din took on the Jedi as his Padawan&mdash;the first one he had taken since Bengel Morr.<ref name="High Tech" /> The discovery that Callef and his "master" were marshaling the Flesh Raiders sparked the Jedi Order to [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|begin investigating]], and the uprising finally ended when Din's new Padawan defeated their leader&mdash;who was revealed to be an insane Morr&mdash;and rescued Din at the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]].<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The duel in the Gnarls cave was created for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the start of the Jedi Knight class storyline. While there are dialogue choices with Callef that can gain alignment points, the duel will end with the Dark Jedi's death regardless of the player's choices.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />
